common.dismiss.description: Button that closes a notice without acting on it. Short.

common.untitledTab.description: Name shown for a tab that has no page title and no web address to show instead.

common.aDevice.description: Stands in for a device name when the sender's name is unknown. Used in “Tab received from {device}”, so it must read as a noun phrase after “from”.

common.list.two.description: Joins exactly two names in a list of devices, e.g. “Pixel 9 and iPad”. Part of a three-message list pattern (two, start, middle, end) like CLDR's list patterns.

common.list.start.description: First join in a list of three or more names. {first} is the first name; {second} is the rest of the list, already joined. e.g. “Pixel 9, iPad and Home PC”.

common.list.middle.description: Join inside a list of four or more names. {first} is one name; {second} is the rest of the list, already joined.

common.list.end.description: Last join in a list of three or more names: the final two names. e.g. “iPad and Home PC”.

common.time.ago.now.description: How long ago something happened when it was under a minute ago. Lowercase, used mid-sentence and in short device rows. Short.

common.time.ago.recently.description: Used when a time cannot be read. Lowercase, short.

common.time.ago.minutes.description: Short relative time: minutes ago. {count} is 1 to 59. Keep it very short (device rows are narrow); the English “m” is an abbreviation for minutes.

common.time.ago.hours.description: Short relative time: hours ago. {count} is 1 to 23. Keep it very short; “h” abbreviates hours.

common.time.ago.days.description: Short relative time: days ago. {count} is 1 or more. Keep it very short; “d” abbreviates days.

common.cancel.description: Button that closes a dialog without changing anything. Short.

common.ok.description: Button that confirms a dialog. Short.

common.rename.description: Button that starts renaming a device. Short.

common.remove.description: Button that removes a device from the group. Short.

common.setUpTabsend.description: Button or link that opens Tabsend's setup page. “Tabsend” is the product name.

common.addDevice.description: Button or heading for adding another browser or phone to the group.

common.settings.description: Name of Tabsend's settings page, used as a button label and a heading. Short.

common.history.description: Name of Tabsend's history page (the list of sent and received tabs), used as a button label and a heading. Short.

common.loading.description: Shown while a page waits for its data. Short.

common.renameDialog.title.description: Title of the dialog for renaming a device. “This device” is the device whose name the person is changing.
